name: radial-chart
title: Radial Chart
description: A live radial chart for json-render chats: 2–5 items as concentric rings against the same full mark (100%, a capacity or a target), researched via Parallel, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   RadialChartCard: radialChartCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: RadialChartCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveRadialChartCard topic={props.topic || undefined} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     RadialChartCard: radialChartLookup

Figures load from /api/radial-chart (installed at app/api/radial-chart/route.ts). The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to measure each item against the same full mark. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). Topic is free text from the user's question.
